name: Default
shortDescription: MindsDB query engine with a web SQL editor that queries databases, warehouses and apps live in one SQL dialect and builds knowledge bases for semantic search.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated MINDSDB_PASSWORD from the environment settings. Knowledge bases and LLM features need an API key from an external model provider such as OpenAI.
Only the HTTP editor and API are published. The MySQL wire protocol on port 47335 stays internal to the stack.
